heart_rate.rationale: ~3 bpm approximates the day-to-day biological noise floor of resting HR and a training-zone-relevant increment; finer resolution is not actionable.

vo2max.rationale: ~3% of a typical 40-50 mL/kg/min value (~1.5 mL/kg/min), matching the smallest change a coach would act on and roughly the CPET test-retest band.
vo2max.criterion_ceiling: CPET (metabolic cart / Douglas bag) test-retest ~3-4% -- a device cannot beat this.

hrv.rationale: Within-subject RMSSD varies enormously day to day; no single absolute SWC generalizes. Grade falls back to agreement coefficients (CCC/ICC) vs ECG.

spo2.rationale: ~2% spans the clinically meaningful desaturation step and aligns with the +/-2% accuracy expected of medical pulse oximeters.

blood_pressure.rationale: ~5 mmHg is the AAMI/ISO mean-difference tolerance for validated cuffs and a clinically meaningful systolic increment.
blood_pressure.criterion_ceiling: Intra-arterial line / validated auscultatory cuff ~+/-5 mmHg

energy_expenditure.rationale: Errors are reported in percent of total expenditure; ~5% is the threshold below which calorie estimates are decision-useful for body-weight goals.

steps.rationale: ~5% step-count error is the practical threshold for activity tracking.

sleep_duration.rationale: ~30 min total-sleep-time error is the threshold for night-to-night usefulness.

sleep_stages.rationale: Staging is categorical (epoch agreement), not a continuous quantity, so no SWC applies; grade uses epoch-agreement / error statistics directly.
sleep_stages.criterion_ceiling: PSG inter-scorer agreement only ~80% of epochs -- the realistic ceiling.
